results.title: Synapseus Technologies launches TapID: homegrown, smart relationship management platform for the world
results.description: Networking events and meetings often result in a surplus of physical business cards which end up forgotten in the back of a drawer and lost opportunities that are unpursued after an initial meeting. Most connections stumble or falter after the first introductions. Synapseus Technologies proudly launches TapID , a Sri Lankan built digital business card and relationship management platform that goes beyond a typical NFC business card and is designed to transform the way professionals network, connect, and build robust relationships. TapID helps individuals and challenges circumvent the challenges that arise with networking by going beyond simply exchanging traditional business cards and contact details. Each introduction is transformed into meaningful connections as people can use their NFC card to tap and share a polished digital profile and save contacts instantly. Further, they are prompted with notes, reminders and follow-up actions to build on these introductions. TapID also offers searchable, exportable networking history as well as team analytics for organizations to make networking smart and efficient. Designed for diverse users, and with a special focus on Sri Lanka’s workforce, the platform currently supports English, Sinhala, Tamil and Arabic and has additional language support in the pipeline. “Every business opportunity begins with a simple conversation, but too many valuable connections are lost in the noise –TapID was inspired by this observation and is intended to bridge this gap and ease the networking process. We envision helping individuals build stronger professional networks while enabling businesses to retain valuable customer relationships. TapID combines multiple networking tools in one seamless platform and demonstrates that we are equipped to build world-class technology in Sri Lanka that can compete on a global stage,” said Milinda Lokuge, Founder and Managing Director, Synapseus Technologies. More than an NFC business card, TapID is a complete networking platform that combines two-way contact exchange, built-in CRM, real-time analytics, and 24-7-30- follow up helping professionals turn every interaction into a lasting business relationship. Designed for both individuals and businesses, the platform enables professionals to grow their networks while helping organisations standardise team branding and improve sales and customer follow-ups. TapID also offers a premium range of NFC products, including business cards, QR codes, NFC Coin Stickers, and compact 6mm NFC Stickers, available in elegant finishes such as natural wood and brushed metal. TapID is also available as a mobile app, allowing you to update your information instantly, anytime, anywhere. Choose from flexible subscription plans with convenient billing in Sri Lankan Rupees. Referral rewards and customizations depending on individual or team requirements are also available for enhanced networking opportunities. For more information visit: https://thetapid.com Synapseus Technologies Founder and Managing Director Milinda Lokuge
